environmentVariables.description: Base URL for the Action1 API. Leave the prefilled default unless your account uses a different regional or self-hosted host.

environmentVariables.name: ACTION1_CLIENT_SECRET

environmentVariables.description: Pre-minted Action1 bearer token, used instead of ACTION1_CLIENT_ID + ACTION1_CLIENT_SECRET. Leave blank when you set the client ID and secret; the CLI mints and refreshes the token itself.
environmentVariables.name: ACTION1_OAUTH2

environmentVariables.description: Organization ID the fleet commands scope to by default (the --org flag overrides it). Leave blank to span every organization your credentials can see.
environmentVariables.name: ACTION1_ORG_ID

environmentVariables.description: Set to 1 to keep credentials off disk. The token cache becomes a no-op, so the connector mints a fresh token each run instead of writing one to config.toml. Leave blank for the default cached behaviour.
environmentVariables.name: ACTION1_NO_CONFIG_WRITE
